_comment: FIRST REAL RECIPE (user content, ADR-006). Targets captured from the LIVE lp.p2p.me site on 2026-07-19 (order 625945) via scripts/capture_now.py. Flow: order popup shows Close -> click Close -> the order maps to the HOME screen as a clean Accept button -> click Accept. The script does ONLY these two clicks; all payment/verification is manual on the phone.
_workflow: Author's real loop: the phone rings 3x per order (1 assigned / 2 accepted / 3 action-needed). The script auto-Closes + auto-Accepts fast and non-stop. On the 3rd ring the author TOGGLES THE SCRIPT OFF (hotkey), handles that one order on the phone (~6-7 min: verify a buy where money arrived, or send money for a sell), then TOGGLES BACK ON. The toggle-pause is what keeps the script from accepting more orders than can be worked one at a time.
_targeting_notes: WHY TEXT/ROLE AND NOT CSS SELECTORS (learned from the capture, do not 'improve' this): lp.p2p.me is React + Tailwind. Buttons have NO ids, only utility classes, and deep nth-of-type paths. Worse, the order popup is a Radix dialog whose container id is generated per-render (e.g. div#radix-«rj») — every CSS path inside the popup is anchored to it and WILL break on the next popup. So CSS fallbacks are deliberately omitted: a stale selector that matches the WRONG control on a financial dashboard is more dangerous than no fallback. Text/role were verified UNIQUE in the captures.
_uniqueness_verified:
With the popup open, exactly 2 elements contain 'Close' and both are the same button (div wrapper + its

label) — unambiguous. On the home screen after closing, exactly 1 element contains 'Accept' and it is a real
name: P2P.me — auto accept & close

steps._note: Waits for the next order popup (Radix dialog). Pausing here via the hotkey is the clean toggle-off point.
Dismisses the popup. Non-committing. Captured rect was 400x48 at (440,640); we target by text, never coords.
Home-screen Accept appears only when an order is pending. role=button+exact avoids matching 'Slide to Accept'/'Accept to view UPI ID'. Falls back to exact text if role lookup fails.
THIS is the auto-accept step — delete it to revert to close-only (script would then just dismiss popups and leave Accept for you to tap).
